TestEverywhereConsistency::test_bootstra.description: Starts a 1-node cluster in dc1 (multi-DC topology), creates an EverywhereStrategy keyspace and writes 100 rows at CL=ALL. Bootstraps a new node in dc2, stops node1, then reads via an exclusive connection to node2 at CL=LOCAL_ONE and asserts all 100 keys are present. Guards that vnode bootstrap streams EverywhereStrategy data to a node in a brand-new DC (consistency of ERS across topology changes, dtest issue #3008 / DTEST-14).
